summary: Docebo Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the commencement of a substantial issuer bid to repurchase for cancellation up to 3,431,372 common shares at US$20.40 per share, for an aggregate price not exceeding US$70 million. The offer expires on August 26, 2026, unless extended. This is a Canadian issuer bid, equivalent to a U.S. tender offer by the issuer. Shareholders should refer to the offer documents on SEDAR+ and EDGAR. Watch for proration and potential price movement as the tender deadline approaches; risk-arb is minimal as it is a self-tender.
